import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
receipts=[]
for p in root.rglob("*.json"):
    value=json.loads(p.read_text())
    if isinstance(value,dict) and value.get("schema")=="results-breakthrough-command-receipt.v1":
        receipts.append((p,value))
assert len(receipts)==23
for p,value in receipts:
    prefix=p.with_suffix("")
    stdout=prefix.with_suffix(".stdout").read_bytes()
    stderr=prefix.with_suffix(".stderr").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(stdout).hexdigest()==value["stdout_sha256"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(stderr).hexdigest()==value["stderr_sha256"]
    assert value["exit_code"]==0
common=pathlib.Path("experiments/results-breakthrough-01/fixtures/common")
assert (root/"session/blind-bundle/result.json").read_bytes()==(common/"result.json").read_bytes()
assert (root/"session/repo/result.json").read_bytes()==(common/"result.json").read_bytes()
assert (root/"session/repo/methods/blinded-review.json").read_bytes()==pathlib.Path("experiments/results-breakthrough-01/arms/V/blinded-review-method.json").read_bytes()
assert (root/"provider-loss-reconstruction/reconstructed/methods/blinded-review.json").read_bytes()==pathlib.Path("experiments/results-breakthrough-01/arms/V/blinded-review-method.json").read_bytes()
show=json.loads((root/"session/organization-only/post-verdict/receipts/show.stdout").read_text())
readback=json.loads((root/"provider-loss-reconstruction/readback.stdout").read_text())
assert show==readback and show["status"]=="rejected"
decision=json.loads((root/"session/organization-only/post-verdict/receipts/decision.stdout").read_text())
assert decision["action"]=="reject" and decision["scientific_state_changed"] is False
replay=json.loads((root/"session/organization-only/post-verdict/receipts/replay.stdout").read_text())
reconstructed=json.loads((root/"provider-loss-reconstruction/replay.stdout").read_text())
for key in ("authority_keyset_root","authority_model_root","counts","git_commit","git_tree","origin_id","origin_root","repository_id","repository_root"):
    assert replay[key]==reconstructed[key]
assert (root/"preflight/source-canonical-pre.stdout").read_bytes()==(root/"postflight/source-canonical-post.stdout").read_bytes()
assert not list((root/"session/private").glob("*"))
assert hashlib.sha256((root/"provider-loss.bundle").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="4c5163f1027002148699409753dcf060f9cbc7cbe64974278c1d4b3831608ef5"
assert json.loads((root/"postflight/credential-scan-host.json").read_text())["outcome"]=="pass"
